verdict.rationale: Webhook signature verification is a fair question for an email API, so the axis applies. The pack only shows that Mailgun pushes real-time event data via webhooks (mailgun-docs-8). Nothing in it mentions signed webhook payloads, a signing key, or verification code samples. The DKIM/SPF/DMARC items cover email sender authentication, not webhook authenticity, so they don't count here.
